name: webpack-externals-does-not-block-analysis
hook: webpack externals doesn't prevent analysis of node: scheme imports
body: webpack.externals marks a module as external so it's not emitted in the bundle, but webpack still analyzes the module for tree-shaking. When analyzing undici (marked external), webpack follows internal imports and encounters 'node:console' / 'node:crypto' etc. which fail because no webpack plugin handles the node: protocol. The fix is to ALSO add resolve.alias to redirect node: imports to an empty stub.
why: CI failed with 'UnhandledSchemeError: Reading from node:console is not handled by plugins' even after adding undici to webpack.externals. The externals approach alone was insufficient because webpack still analyzes the module internals.

name: next-config-js-uses-esm-require-unavailable
hook: next.config.js is ESM — use path.resolve not require.resolve
body: next.config.js uses ESM (import at top level), so require is not available. When adding webpack resolve.alias entries that need a file path, use path.resolve(process.cwd(), ...) instead of require.resolve(...). process.cwd() gives the project root at build time, matching what require.resolve would have resolved to.
why: CI failed with 'ReferenceError: require is not defined' at next.config.js:155 because the file is ESM but used require.resolve in the webpack config callback.
